docs: Canonical session/tree color palette shared by wt-cli and claude-planter. Each color: hue (degrees, drives plant sprite art), primary (identity color), text (labels on dark ground), tint (near-black terminal background). Order is load-bearing: wt hashes into the array by index, and planter's slot bookkeeping is index-aligned. Tints must keep HSV saturation >= 0.15 or the ghostty balatro shader stops tinting its swirl. Copies in wt-cli/src/color.rs, claude-planter/Palette.swift, and claude-planter/planter-state are checked against this file by tools/check-palette.
